# Security Policy

## Supported Versions
Security fixes are released for the latest major version only.

| Version | Supported |
| :---: | :---: |
| 3.x | ✅ |
| < 3.0 | ❌ |


## Reporting a Vulnerability
Please don't report security issues in public GitHub issues or in the support server. Report them privately by [opening a security advisory](https://github.com/guardbotgg/framework/security/advisories/new) on GitHub instead.

Please include:
- What an attacker could do, and what they'd need to do it, like a message any user can send or access to the bot's files.
- The affected versions.
- The steps or code needed to reproduce it.

We'll get back to you once we've looked into it. The fix will credit you, unless you'd rather stay anonymous.
Vulnerabilities in discord.js itself should be reported to the [discord.js team](https://github.com/discordjs/discord.js/security).
